name: Nash County, NC
findings: Nash County has 294 nonprofit organizations. 108 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Nash County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 hobby and sports organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?
